subject.title: fix(openai): bound image generation SSE body reads with idle timeout

question: Should `readChunkWithIdleTimeout` become a supported public `media-runtime` plugin SDK export for bundled and external extensions, or should this timeout behavior use a narrower owner-approved SDK seam?
rationale: The patch widens a public plugin API to let the OpenAI extension use an internal shared helper; repository policy treats that contract as compatibility-sensitive, and the correct permanent extension seam requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve the shared SDK export
options.body: Accept the additive export as the reusable extension contract after the PR adds controlled production-path proof for stalled and slow-valid SSE streams.

options.title: Use a narrower extension seam
options.body: Keep the generic helper internal and expose only an owner-approved media response-reader contract if maintainers do not want the low-level reader helper as public SDK.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared SDK export
recommendation.body: Accept the additive export as the reusable extension contract after the PR adds controlled production-path proof for stalled and slow-valid SSE streams.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work is the closest available history signal for the shared timeout-reader behavior and proof contract.
